categories_thin: Roofing, siding and windows: still thin. About a dozen firms with in-city addresses are listed, but most came from bulk directories (all-contractors.com, Birdeye, BBB) without a phone, and the window-installation side is dominated by Angi-listed firms based in East Brunswick, Edison and North Brunswick. No independent in-city window shop was confirmed.

Pest control: only two New Brunswick operators, East Coast Termite Exterminators and Arrow Exterminating; other results (Lawn Doctor, Insight Pest Solutions, EcoShield, Viking, Terminix, Mosquito Shield) are franchise or multi-branch brands and were excluded.

Locksmiths: Allied Safe & Lock at 2 Elizabeth St is the only shop-style listing found and it is single-directory only; every other result is a city-name website or mobile dispatch service (several clustered on the 230-248 Livingston Ave corridor).
Pools: almost all pool companies covering New Brunswick are based elsewhere; only International Swimming Pools and Elite Lawn Sprinklers have in-city addresses.

Moving and storage: in-city options are mostly broker-style or city-name listings plus national self-storage chains (excluded). No independently owned New Brunswick moving company with a confirmed in-city yard was found.

Restoration and water damage: the New Brunswick-branded providers (SERVPRO, Roto-Rooter, Paul Davis, PuroClean) are franchises or national brands and were excluded; only Element Water Damage Restoration, New Jersey Mold Specialist and Atlantis Waterproofing remain.
Cleaning: many results were national or franchise cleaning brands (e.g. Purify Pros, whose New Brunswick listing points to a franchise site) or individual cleaners without a business address.
caveats: Zone is the City of New Brunswick. Contractors based in North Brunswick, East Brunswick, Highland Park, Milltown, Somerset or Edison that merely serve New Brunswick were excluded unless they list a New Brunswick street address.

Removed since the first pass, per verification: On Tap Plumbing (no listing or phone found anywhere), FBS Security Systems at 120 Albany St (company operates from Fords, NJ), Vulcan Basement Waterproofing (multi-branch brand, no local address), Sewer-Man (brand with town service pages across NJ), The LockSmith People (nationwide-service dispatch site), Families On the Move (listing inactive; tax-exempt status revoked in 2008), and W Galaxy Cleaning Service (based in Somerset, NJ).

Several contractor 'brands' share 317 George St Suite 320: NJ Commercial and Industrial Roofing, Castlestone Paving, Princeton Electrical Makeover and (per its site listing) Warren Thompson & Son Roofing & Siding. This looks like a shared office or marketing set-up and should be verified as separate operating businesses.

120 Albany St appears both as New Brunswick Locksmith Corp's own stated address and formerly as a security-installer address, which suggests a shared or virtual address; treat any 120 Albany St listing as unconfirmed.

Street addresses marked 'directory-derived, unverified' (Precision Plumbing, Carter & Sons, Lifetime Construction) came from directory data and are not shown on the companies' own sites; confirm on a map before any in-person visit.
The 118-120 Sandford St and 1100 Somerset St industrial buildings house many one-bay body/repair shops with unit numbers; several may share owners or be dormant. Cross-check before outreach.
Auto-body entries taken from the NJ MVC licensed facility PDF are state-licensed but may have no web presence; 'active_evidence' reflects the licence list, not recent reviews.
Entries sourced only from all-contractors.com are bulk-directory records with no phone and no reviews; they are included for completeness but are the lowest-confidence group in this list.
Genie Tree Service is not confirmed active: the state tree-expert directory snippet shows 'suspended', and it shares 105 Townsend St with United Tree Service.
Some review counts (e.g., Everest Driveways 395, T&J Stone 122) look large for a small local firm and may reflect aggregated or incentivised reviews.
data_gaps: OpenStreetMap/Overpass API returned HTTP 406 from this environment, so no OSM cross-check was possible.

Yellow Pages, Yelp, BBB, Superpages, Manta, Cylex, AllPages and ShowMeLocal block direct page fetches (HTTP 403 or JavaScript-only rendering); their content was read only through search-result snippets, so entries resting on them (Allied Safe & Lock, Three Painters, Bill Weaver Roofing, Jeffrey's Cleaning Service, Prolawn, C. Earl Fisher phone) could not be verified in depth.

The NJ Board of Tree Experts business directory could not be opened directly; the 'suspended' status for Genie Tree Service comes from a search-result snippet and needs re-checking at nj.gov/njbte before any outreach.
Birdeye pages 6 and 7 of the New Brunswick contractors directory (listings roughly 51-70) returned truncated content, so about a dozen entries in that range were missed.
Google Maps served a limited view (about five results per query) and the shared browser session was contended by other research sessions, limiting map-based enumeration.
The City of New Brunswick publishes no reachable online business-licence directory; only the French Street/Joyce Kilmer corridor directory was available.
Phone numbers are missing for many small shops whose directories omit them; the triage team should pull them from map listings.

Excluded as chain/franchise or out-of-zone while re-checking thin categories: Insight Pest Solutions (11 Jules Lane; multi-branch), Lawn Doctor of SE Mercer & Middlesex (7F Jules Lane; franchise), Paul Davis Restoration of Middlesex County (11 Jules Ln; franchise), SERVPRO of East Brunswick (South River; franchise), College Hunks Hauling Junk & Moving (625 Jersey Ave; franchise), Purify Pros (197 Jersey Ave; franchise site), Environmina Pest Control (Middlesex borough).
Franklin Reliable Movers remains unresolved: the directory shows 170 Hamilton St, New Brunswick while the FMCSA carrier record shows a Somerset address; needs a phone check.
